context: The recent Cloudflare build failure (cheer.js/missions.js/ranking-submit.js importing the wrong relative path to db.js) exposed a structural problem: shared helper modules (db.js, _ai.js, _moderation.js, auth/_shared.js) were scattered directly among route files with no consistent depth rule, and 3 fully dead duplicate files existed alongside the real ones (api/ai.js, api/moderation.js, api/auth/shared.js -- identical content, no onRequest export, only differing in which duplicate they imported). This made it easy to import the wrong one and break the build, and it already happened once.

what_changed.new_lib_folder: All shared, non-routable helpers moved into functions/api/_lib/ (underscore prefix keeps the whole folder out of Cloudflare Pages' automatic routing): db.js (requireDB, json), ai.js (runChat, requireAI, AI_MODEL -- moved from _ai.js), moderation.js (moderateText -- moved from _moderation.js), social-auth.js (redirectToApp, upsertSocialUserAndIssueToken -- moved from auth/_shared.js).
what_changed.one_rule_for_all_imports: Every route file now follows exactly one depth rule instead of having to remember where db.js happens to sit: files directly under functions/api/*.js import as './_lib/xxx.js'; files under any functions/api/<folder>/*.js (auth, dm, favorites, presence, users, admin) import as '../_lib/xxx.js'. No more per-file guessing.
what_changed.dead_files_removed: Deleted api/ai.js, api/moderation.js, api/auth/shared.js -- byte-for-byte or near-identical duplicates of the real _lib files that had zero onRequest exports (unreachable as routes) and existed only as traps for future copy-paste mistakes.
what_changed.docs_updated: functions/README.md now documents the _lib convention and the one-rule-for-imports guidance directly, so future edits (human or AI) don't reintroduce the same class of bug.

verification.syntax: node --check passes on all 29 remaining .js files under functions/.
verification.import_resolution: Wrote a script that resolves every relative import in functions/ against the filesystem -- all resolve to real files, zero broken paths (this is the same class of check that would have caught the original ../db.js bug and the earlier _shared.js/shared.js confusion before deployment).
verification.route_count_unchanged: All 25 actual API routes (onRequestGet/onRequestPost exports) are untouched in behavior -- only their import paths changed. No endpoint URLs changed.

deployment.note: Push this to GitHub and Cloudflare will pick it up on the next auto-deploy; no dashboard config changes needed since the route URLs (/api/...) are unchanged.
